card.name: Space before a dose amount
card.fires_on: The space or opening parenthesis right before a dose amount such as 100 mg or 0.6 mg. It appears in dosing sentences for drugs like dapsone, colchicine, chloroquine and primaquine.

modes.label: Space before number
modes.description: A blank space after a drug name, 'dosage of', or 'is', just before the dose number.
modes.example: patients, the recommendation is the coadministration of Dapsone<< >>100 mg daily with two years

modes.label: Parenthesis before equivalent
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a tablet count, just before an equivalent amount.

card.plain: It fires at the spot just before a dose amount is written out in a dosing sentence.
